source.reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee Add/Remove/Set paths, AssignTo attributes, and documented HTTP verb/version values. UI template contains an unexplained Properties element, kept incomplete. Set/Path is documented as not working as designed. Context-dependent request/response constraints and templates are not cross-validated.
